name: GA-08
label: Safe R

key_factors: Incumbent Austin Scott running with large financial advantage
Prediction markets price Republican win at ~94%
model.rationale: Austin Scott holds a heavily Republican district with a decisive cash advantage, while Kelly Esti has raised almost nothing; markets and fundamentals both point to an easy Republican hold.
model.watch: Any late surge in challenger fundraising or outside spending would be the only realistic path to narrowing this race.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Georgia's 8th District leans Republican by about fifteen points, and incumbent Austin Scott is seeking another term with the advantages that status brings. He has raised over $1.1 million and holds roughly $1.3 million on hand, while Democratic challenger Kelly Esti has raised under $20,000 and reported minimal cash. No outside groups are meaningfully engaged on either side.

No public polls or expert ratings cover this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and the lopsided resource gap. Prediction markets give Scott about a 94% chance of winning. The forecast is a comfortable Republican hold, with low uncertainty given how little evidence exists of a competitive race.
